_doc: STAKEHOLDERS-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-17): who the site is for, what each of them needs, and the path each takes. Source of truth for /for, /for/<id>, /showcase and /showcase/<id> and for the home entry points; site/stakeholders.js is generated from this file by scripts/gen_stakeholders.py and site/site.test.mjs fails if a path step does not resolve, a story is malformed or an audience has no single primary action. To add a domain or a showcase, add a row here; no page code changes. Figures that are estimates say so. No secrets, no unverified claims.

audiences.name: Founders and idea people
audiences.promise: Start with a rough idea. The system works out what to build next and keeps shipping it.
audiences.needs: Direction without code, a clear budget and proof that it is working.

stories.want: to say my idea out loud or in a sentence
stories.so: I do not have to know what to ask for

stories.want: to know if my idea is a fit before anything is built
stories.so: I do not pay for machinery I do not need

stories.want: to see what changed, why and whether it worked
stories.so: I can trust the system without reading code

audiences.name: Nonprofits and communities
audiences.promise: Practical help for small teams and good causes, run by a system that keeps improving it.
audiences.needs: Plain words, low cost, nothing to install and a way to see that it does good.

stories.want: routine work handled and kept up to date
stories.so: our few people can focus on the cause

stories.want: to see how the practical-help project is doing
stories.so: I can decide whether to help or to use it

stories.want: to know the cost and the limits up front

cta.label: Talk to us about your community

audiences.name: Developers and engineering teams
audiences.promise: A control loop around the coding agents you already use: it picks the work, proves each change live and reverts regressions.
audiences.needs: Source, an API, agent hooks and an audit trail.

stories.want: to connect my coding agent in one click
stories.so: it takes work from the shared queue

stories.want: an audit trail of every agent change and its prediction
stories.so: I can review decisions, not diffs

stories.want: failed deploys to revert and file their own issue
stories.so: nobody pages me for a known failure

audiences.name: Funders and investors
audiences.promise: One operating system with two live test cases and its own cost and failure record.
audiences.needs: Evidence, status without hype, risks and the licence terms.

stories.want: to see measured results, not claims
stories.so: I can judge the work on evidence

stories.want: the licence and commercial terms plainly stated
stories.so: I know what can and cannot be done with it
I know what stage this is at

audiences.name: Partners and press
audiences.promise: A system that develops itself and its products with one loop. The story, the evidence and a person to ask.
audiences.needs: A short story, citable facts and a contact.

stories.want: a plain explanation with checkable facts
to see where the work fits mine
the decision records and failure history
stories.so: I can study how autonomous systems behave

showcases.name: QNFO
showcases.summary: A large service fleet that Ultrastable ran as customer zero. It exposed real failures, real cost and real limits, then handed the fixes to the platform.
showcases.problem: The audit database read billions of rows a week, mostly from triggers and scans that ran on every tick, and every deploy touched more workers than the change needed.
showcases.loop: The cost loop measured reads per query, traced them to their source, filed the work with a closing probe, and the executor shipped it. Deploys now name the workers they touch and are capped.
results: Audit database daily rows read: 1.37 billion on 11-12, 0.32 billion on 11-16, about 63 million a day over the latest six hours. Part of the drop is a deploy freeze, so "about 95%" is an estimate until the next unfrozen reading.
Worst single query: 2.5 million rows down to under 6,000.
showcases.separate: QNFO is a separate, earlier project and is not Ultrastable. It is no longer in active development; its papers and pages stay online at qnfo.org. It appears here only as the testbed Ultrastable was first proven on.
showcases.learned: Cost is a loop to close like any failure. The fixes now live in the platform, not in QNFO.

showcases.name: Practical Solutions
showcases.summary: A practical-help project bootstrapped from an idea on Ultrastable, with its own database and web Worker on the platform's account.
showcases.problem: A good idea with no team: it needs building, running and improving without its owner handling code or infrastructure.
showcases.loop: The same loop that runs the platform runs this system: it states a charter, measures itself, files its own work and proves each change live.
results: Live web Worker and database on the Ultrastable account (see the operations dashboard).
Bootstrapped from an idea file; no code written by the owner.
showcases.learned: A second system on the platform shows the loop is general, not specific to one product.
